newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse ends narrowly in the red.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse ends narrowly in the red.

text.p: 1450 GMT - Bel-20 index .BFX ends varied day with light losses as steam for early mild rally runs out and New York opens lower. Future short-term direction uncertain.
* Bel-20 index down 2.29 points or 0.10 percent to 2,245.54, with seven gainers and 13 losers. Some 2.6 billion francs of Belgian shares traded.

* Main gainer holding company Ackermans, up 5.5 percent to 7,300 francs, followed by film finisher Spector, up 2.8 percent to 2,560 francs. Main loser glassmaker Glaverbel, down 2.4 percent to 4,420 francs. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
